title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Numbness in feet and follow-up for type 2 diabetes.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up regarding his type 2 diabetes mellitus and associated polyneuropathy. He reports persistent tingling and a "pins and needles" sensation in both feet, which has been present for several months. He describes the sensation as constant but notes it is more noticeable at night. He has been managed on insulin for several years and reports adherence to his current regimen. He denies any acute foot ulcers or recent changes in sensation.

Medication List
Insulin (long-term)

Exam
General: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
Extremities: Symmetrical sensation diminished in the distal lower extremities. No visible skin breakdown or ulcerations noted on the feet. Pedal pulses are palpable.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus
2. Polyneuropathy

Plan
1. Continue current insulin regimen as prescribed.
2. Monitor for any worsening of peripheral neuropathy symptoms.
3. Patient instructed to perform daily foot inspections to check for skin integrity.
4. Follow up in 3 months for laboratory work and clinical evaluation.
explanations: Polyneuropathy is listed under 'with' for diabetes: the combination code E11.42 captures both.
Long-term insulin use in type 2 diabetes: add Z79.4.

distractors.why: Coding the two separately misses the presumed link.
Z79.4 is required for routine insulin use in type 2 diabetes.
